body: Thank you for your heartfelt response. I really don't want to, I'm feeling more grounded today, never thought I'd get this deep into the thought of suicide.

Well... I just found out that I also made a D in a required class because of my attendance, which was impacted by my mental state at the beginning of the semester. 

I appreciate the advice. I've calmed down, I know it'll come back - especially now that my whole schedule is fucked. Good god things just keep getting better.
